#!/bin/bash
# Script to set up the environment from .env.test

# Source the .env.test file to load environment variables
if [ -f .env.test ]; then
    export ADMIN_TOKEN="$(cat .env.test | grep API_KEY | cut -d= -f2)"
    echo "Environment setup complete."
else
    echo ".env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi
